example.en: Her felicitous remarks made everyone at the dinner feel at ease.
example.zh: 她得体的言谈让晚宴上的每个人都感到自在。

name: prolific
trans: 多产的；多子嗣的；丰富的

example.en: Shakespeare was one of the most prolific writers in English literature.
example.zh: 莎士比亚是英国文学史上最多产的作家之一。

example.en: The novel has left an enduring impression on generations of readers.
example.zh: 这部小说给一代又一代读者留下了持久的印象。

example.en: The new evidence helped bolster her argument in the debate.
example.zh: 新的证据帮助她在辩论中支持了自己的论点。

example.en: The witness's account corroborates what the police already suspected.
example.zh: 目击者的陈述证实了警方此前的怀疑。

example.en: Demand for electric cars is outstripping supply this year.
example.zh: 今年电动汽车的需求正超过供应。

name: marvel
trans: 令人惊奇的事物；惊异于

example.en: The Great Wall is one of the wonders that travelers marvel at.
example.zh: 长城是游客们惊叹的世界奇迹之一。

name: meticulous
trans: 小心翼翼的；一丝不苟的

example.en: She kept meticulous records of every expense during the trip.
example.zh: 她一丝不苟地记录了旅途中的每一笔开销。

example.en: Reading this book was an edifying experience for the young students.
example.zh: 读这本书对年轻学生来说是一次启迪性的经历。

example.en: His sense of humor always lightens the mood in the office.
example.zh: 他的幽默感总能缓和办公室的气氛。

example.en: The professor's erudition impressed everyone in the seminar.
example.zh: 教授的博学给研讨会上的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

example.en: Please be discreet about this matter and do not mention it to others.
example.zh: 这件事请你谨慎处理，不要对别人提起。

example.en: She gave a tactful answer that avoided hurting anyone's feelings.
example.zh: 她给出了一个得体的回答，避免伤害任何人的感情。
